messages:
acme_sre: Hey team — we're seeing the streaming endpoint close after the first chunk when routing through our corporate proxy. curl from a dev laptop (no proxy) works fine. error from curl: 'Recv failure: Connection reset by peer'.

tonys_cs: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact curl you used and one failing request_id from our logs? Also let us know your proxy type (squid/bluecoat/etc).

acme_sre: Here's a minimal repro we tried (we use a proxy):

```
TOKEN=REDACTED
curl -v -s -N --no-buffer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  --proxy http://corp-proxy:8080 \
  "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/stream?model=gpt-small&prompt=hi"
```

We get the headers back then connection closes after first data chunk. Request id (from console): req_20240318_abc123

jamal_sre: Thanks — two quick asks: 1) please run the same curl with `-i --raw --no-buffer -v` so we can see connection/transfer encoding and TLS handshake logs; 2) if possible reproduce without the proxy and paste both outputs. That will tell us if proxy is modifying chunked transfer.

lina_devx: Also add an explicit `X-Request-ID: req_20240318_abc123` header to your curl so our ingest logs will have an exact match: `-H "X-Request-ID: req_20240318_abc123"`.

acme_sre: Got it. Re-ran without proxy — streaming is stable. With proxy, here's the `-v` tail (sanitized):

```
* Connected to api.redwood.inference (34.56.78.90) port 443 (#0)
> GET /v1/stream?model=gpt-small&prompt=hi HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.inference
> Authorization: Bearer ***
> Accept: text/event-stream
> X-Request-ID: req_20240318_abc123
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
< transfer-encoding: chunked
<
data: {
  "id": "tok_1",
}
* recv failed: Connection reset by peer
* Closing connection 0
```

jamal_sre: That `transfer-encoding: chunked` plus proxy reset is a strong hint the proxy is buffering or timing out on chunked streams. Could you check the proxy logs around that time for any connection reset or request timeout? Also capture a short pcap if you can: `sudo tcpdump -i any host 34.56.78.90 and port 443 -w /tmp/redwood_stream.pcap` while reproducing.

acme_sre: Proxy team says default timeout is 15s and they see a FIN from the proxy. We'll bump the idle timeout to 120s and try.

lina_devx: If changing the proxy timeout isn't possible, a temporary workaround is to disable proxy for calls to api.redwood.inference (no_proxy) or use our bulk non-streaming endpoint to poll for results. Not ideal but helpful to triage.

acme_sre: Timeout bump made — streaming now works through proxy. Confirmed with `X-Request-ID: req_20240318_abc123`. Thanks! :tada:

tony_cs: Great — we'll mark this as proxied-buffering issue. Jamal, can you add a short note in incidents channel about proxy timeout guidance for customers (15s -> recommend 120s for SSE)?

jamal_sre: Yep will do — adding a small KB blurb and updating support runbook. deploy-bot: uploaded debug bundle for req_20240318_abc123 (logs + ingress traces) :white_check_mark:

acme_sre: Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick help.

lina_devx: Thanks for confirming — closing the thread after KB entry. :thumbsup:
